chunks.text: This section introduces the concept of hierarchical chunking. Headers are structured so systems can split the document logically.
The purpose is to demonstrate how headings and subheadings create a hierarchy that can be used for document parsing and chunking.
This scope includes text sections and embedded media such as images.

Below is an example image included in the document. Images can be referenced during chunking or metadata extraction.

[IMAGE: Sample Embedded Image]
